title: Rewrite Kit API to Stateful With Five Kit Kinds
description: Rewrite everything from functional style to stateful style programming to avoid expensive memory copies. Implement five kit kinds: DevKit (synchronized json file), LocalKit (synchronized folder with .compose/kit.db), TransportKit (static json string), ArchiveKit (static zipped local kit), RemoteKit (synchronized websocket to compose/hub). All synchronized kits must have the same API, support import/export of static kits, and all CRUDs must use exclusively diffs. Implement for every programming language (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, C#/.NET).
